imp.title: Import & export
imp.intro: Load your data from a sheet. Choose what you want to load, check what would change, then apply only what you saw: nothing is written before you apply.

what.title: What do you want to load?
what.noneTitle: No import is open to you
what.noneBody: Each import also needs the right to change what it loads (materials, customers and suppliers, locations, stock). Ask an administrator.
what.later: Styles, price lists and workers get their imports with their own areas; the guided first load (customers → suppliers → materials → opening stock, with totals that must match) and the downloadable templates for every import come later.

recent.title: Recent imports
recent.emptyBody: Every sheet you check or apply is listed here, with what it changed.

held.noRunRight: You need the rights to run imports and to upload files.
held.noImporter: No import is open to you.
held.noApplyRight: Applying needs the right to apply imports: ask someone who holds it.
held.nothing: Nothing to apply: every row is unchanged or refused.

wizard.title: Import a sheet
wizard.subtitle: Nothing is written until you apply.

reading.label: Reading the sheet
reading.detail: Checking every row of {file} against what is there now.
reading.note: You can close this window: the check goes on, and the import waits under Recent imports.

applying.note: You can close this window: the import goes on. A row changed since the check is skipped, never overwritten.

applyFailed.title: The apply stopped
applyFailed.body: {written} rows were written before it stopped and stay written; {left} are left. Apply again to go on from where it stopped.

cancelled.title: This import was cancelled
cancelled.someWritten_one: 1 row was written before it was cancelled and stays written; nothing more will be.
cancelled.someWritten_other: {count} rows were written before it was cancelled and stay written; nothing more will be.

cancel.title: Cancel this import?
cancel.body: The planned changes are dropped and nothing more is written. To load this sheet later, upload it again.

upload.intro: Choose what the sheet holds and for which company, then the file. The next step shows what would change.
upload.openingReports: A sheet that names chromium VI test reports needs those PDFs uploaded first; uploading them comes with the stock page. Without reports, lots that need the test wait in quarantine.
upload.safe: Checking writes nothing. Rows that are wrong are refused with their reason; the others wait for you to apply them.

field.companyHint: The records are written for this company.
field.fileHint: A .csv or .xlsx file, up to 10 MB and 10,000 rows. The first row holds the column names.
field.sheetHint: Leave it empty to read the first worksheet of the file.

numbers.sample: One thousand two hundred and thirty-four and a half: {sample}

checked.nothingYet: This is the check: nothing has been written yet. Apply writes the new and changed rows; refused rows are never written.
checked.again: The check of this sheet, as it was before the apply stopped.
checked.refusedHint: Fix them in the sheet and import it again; the rows already loaded come back as unchanged.
checked.moreRefused_one: 1 more refused row is in the download.
checked.moreRefused_other: {count} more refused rows are in the download.
checked.moreChanges_one: 1 more row would be written (not shown).
checked.moreChanges_other: {count} more rows would be written (not shown).
checked.allSame: Everything in the sheet is already in Nexus: there is nothing to apply.

planFailed.title: The sheet could not be checked as it is
planFailed.body: Nothing was written. Correct the sheet and upload it again.
planFailed.money: These columns hold money values you may not see: {columns}. Remove them, or ask someone who sees them to import the sheet.

result.skippedHint: changed since the check, not overwritten
result.refusedHint: Fix the refused rows in the sheet and import it again.

problem.fileType: Only .csv and .xlsx files are read: save the sheet as one of them.
problem.fileSize: The file is larger than 10 MB: split it into smaller sheets.
problem.store: The sheet could not be sent to the file store. Try again.

product_materials.name: Materials
product_materials.fills: Leathers, fabrics, trims and protectors with their units, colours, chromium VI settings and standard cost.

parties_parties.name: Customers and suppliers
parties_parties.fills: Customers, brands, suppliers, subcontractors and carriers with their tax identity, registered office and a contact.

inventory_locations.name: Locations
inventory_locations.fills: A site's warehouses, zones and bins, the goods-in dock, the quarantine shelf and line-side racks; parents first.

inventory_opening.name: Opening stock
inventory_opening.fills: The stock on hand before Nexus: lots, hides one by one with their areas, linings, trims and protectors, with their existing chromium VI reports. Lots that need the quality step wait in quarantine.

bulk.none: None of the selected imports can be cancelled: only one still being checked, or checked and not applied, can.
bulk.body: Their planned changes are dropped and nothing is written from these sheets. To load one later, upload it again.

left.applying_one: 1 selected import is being applied right now: left out.
left.applying_other: {count} selected imports are being applied right now: left out.
left.applyFailed_one: 1 selected import stopped while applying: open it to apply it again or cancel it; left out.
left.applyFailed_other: {count} selected imports stopped while applying: open each to apply it again or cancel it; left out.
left.planFailed_one: 1 selected import could not be checked: nothing to cancel; left out.
left.planFailed_other: {count} selected imports could not be checked: nothing to cancel; left out.
left.applied_one: 1 selected import is applied already: left out.
left.applied_other: {count} selected imports are applied already: left out.
left.cancelled_one: 1 selected import is cancelled already: left out.
left.cancelled_other: {count} selected imports are cancelled already: left out.

bulk.done_one: 1 import cancelled: nothing is written from it.
bulk.done_other: {count} imports cancelled: nothing is written from them.
bulk.failed_other: None of the {count} imports was cancelled:
